name: Seraphion
source:
Archangel, Princess and commander of the Angelic Host's military. Seraphion was a gentle soul until King [url=https://vndb.org/c165575]Xal'Zorrak[/url] corrupted her [url=https://vndb.org/c165775]mother[/url] and took her away to live with the Horde. Seraphion has little time for outsiders since she lost her mother to the outsider Xal'Zorrak. Seraphion doesn't understand [url=https://vndb.org/c165588]the Divine[/url]'s fascination with humans and sometimes wonders if it isn't time to return to the world her race fled.
